title: Moving Stones Until Consecutive
description: Given three stones at positions a, b, and c, find the minimum and maximum moves to make them consecutive.
pseudocode:
1. sort(a, b, c)
2. if a + 2 == c: return [0, 0]
3. min_moves = (b-a == 2 or c-b == 2) ? 1 : 2
4. max_moves = (c - a) - 2

steps.note: Check if stones are already consecutive (1+2 == 3 is false).
Calculate minimum moves. Since gaps are size 2 (3-1=2, 5-3=2), min moves is 1.
